facts.item_missing: the reader knows one cherished item is gone
facts.hero_discomfort: the hero is mildly, comically worse off without it
facts.search_intent: the hero has committed to looking
facts.cleared:LANDMARK_A: the reader knows the item is not at the first landmark
facts.cleared:LANDMARK_B: the reader knows the item is not at the second landmark
facts.cleared:FRIEND: the friend has not seen the item
facts.lead:MEETING_PLACE: the reader has a concrete reason to go to the meeting place next
facts.glimpse:ITEM_COLOR: a color-matched sign has been noticed at the meeting place, deliberately ambiguous
facts.item_sighted: the item, or an unmistakable part of it, has been seen
facts.item_out_of_reach: the item is visible but cannot be taken by the hero alone
facts.helpers_alerted: the helper animals are engaged in the search
facts.helpers_group_effort: friends are physically cooperating to reach the item
facts.home_comfort: the hero is home, warm, and welcomed
facts.item_recovered: the item is back with the hero
facts.reveal:never_lost: the item was never at any search site
facts.shared:HOME_TREAT: the treat is shared in company
facts.friendship_payoff: the shared effort is celebrated together

containers.note: something the hero carries or wears home

affect.target: warm, then a small comic dismay

loss_moment.note: how the item came to be gone; never the hero's fault, never theft

n_start.reentry_contract: Re-rendered on every return from a failed search. Write the loss as an established fact the hero is living with, not as fresh news; no oh-no discovery beat.
n_start.beat_hint: hub. establish the want and the three ways to chase it.

constraints.clue_must_be: readable by a four-year-old without inference: one thing, pointing one way
constraints.must_not: explain the clue in a second sentence; the image carries it

n_pine.reentry_contract: May be re-read after a loop; write the empty search as a calm check, not a dashed hope.

choice_semantics.c_pine_back: abandon this lead, resume at the hub

n_pine.beat_hint: the search comes up empty, but the place gives up a direction.

n_rabbit.reentry_contract: May be re-read after a loop; the friend stays warm and unhurried on a second ask.

choice_semantics.c_rabbit_back: abandon this lead, resume at the hub

n_rabbit.beat_hint: the peer has not seen it, but something they noticed points onward.

n_sled.reentry_contract: May be re-read after a loop; write the empty search as a calm check, not a dashed hope.

choice_semantics.c_sled_back: abandon this lead, resume at the hub

n_sled.beat_hint: the play surface is clear, but it holds a trace pointing onward.

constraints.glimpse_must_be: a color-matched sign only, never confirmably the item itself; the surprise ending depends on this ambiguity
constraints.offers: three concrete, sensory offers matching the three choices; each offer stands alone

n_creek.merge_note: NC-1: three parents (n_pine, n_rabbit, n_sled) each arrive with a DIFFERENT clue channel assigned; presuppose none of them specifically. Reference the lead generically.

choice_semantics.c_creek_red: go directly for the color-matched sign
choice_semantics.c_creek_home: let the search rest and head home to comfort

n_creek.beat_hint: the meeting place makes three offers at once: something seen, something heard, something homeward.

choice_semantics.c_birds_help: call friends to reach it together

n_birds.beat_hint: the helpers reveal the item, visible but just beyond the hero's reach.

n_help.beat_hint: friends assemble a cheerful cooperative reach; the fun is the wobble, never the risk.

container.note: must be something the hero has carried or worn the whole story; plant it here naturally

choice_semantics.c_cocoa_surprise: look at what just turned up

n_cocoa.beat_hint: home receives the hero warmly; as outdoor things come off, something color-matched appears.

n_found.merge_note: NC-1: parents are n_creek (ambiguous glimpse) and n_birds (sighted, was out of reach, hero chose to reach alone). Write the recovery on what both guarantee: the item is now seen and takeable by the hero alone. Do not presuppose ground level or reaching up.
n_found.beat_hint: the hero completes the recovery alone; both hands warm; cozy solo win.

n_together.beat_hint: the cooperative reach succeeds; the celebration belongs to everyone.

constraints.reveal_must_not: retroactively claim the color-matched sign at the meeting place was the item; that sign stays its own small mystery or is gently explained as something else

n_surprise.beat_hint: it was with them all along; everybody laughs; nobody is embarrassed.
